craft_notes: Sthāyin: distinguishing mother-love. Device: comma line 1 dropped? Kept: dash→comma line 1 (making softens), comma→dash line 2 (mothering lands). Rejected: 'bears' for 'mothers' — kept mothers (jananī). Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: All fair and foul thou makest thyself, yet love of thee
mothers the fair alone — solely, Lord.
l4.sanskrit_cite: śubhāśubhasya sarvasya svayaṃ kartā bhavān api bhavadbhaktis tu jananī śubhasyaiveśa kevalam

reads_against.argmap: Of all auspicious and inauspicious yourself the doer you are.; But devotion to you is mother of auspicious alone, O lord, only. → You do all; devotion mothers only auspicious.
